title: AppState: add send/receipt/error tracking fields
description:
**What:** Extend AppState with 5 new fields needed for send, read receipts, and error notification.

**Algorithm:**
1. In app.rs AppState struct, add:
   - pub should_send_message: bool           // signals async send from handle_key
   - pub error_notification: Option<(String, std::time::Instant)>  // 3s error display
   - pub message_ids: VecDeque<String>        // JMAP IDs parallel to messages
   - pub message_senders: VecDeque<String>    // senderId parallel to messages
   - pub unread_message_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String>  // inbound unread IDs
2. In AppState::new(), initialize all 5 fields to their zero value (false, None, empty VecDeque, empty VecDeque, empty HashSet).
3. Add method: pub fn set_error(&mut self, msg: &str) sets error_notification = Some((msg.to_string(), std::time::Instant::now()))
4. Add method: pub fn clear_stale_error(&mut self) checks if error_notification elapsed > 3s; if so, sets it to None.
5. Add use std::collections::HashSet at top of app.rs (VecDeque already imported).

**Defensive rules:**
- Never unwrap() the Instant arithmetic; use checked_duration_since or saturating_sub.
- message_ids and message_senders MUST remain parallel (same length) as messages at all times — document this invariant in a comment.
- Do not add should_send_message to the placeholder messages in new().

**Agent team:** R reads app.rs; I adds fields and methods; T tests new() initializes them correctly and clear_stale_error works; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.
